body.how_to_hire: POST /v1/handshake { candidate: { address: "<registry name>", kind: "mcp-registry" }, task, tool, args, dispatch: true }: the broker reads the server’s own latest registry record and calls its open remote (initialize, tools/list, one tools/call); the reply is held under its keccak digest.
body.readiness: open = a streamable-http https remote with no required header and no URL template, from the record alone; probe (?probe=1, at most 20 per page) = a live MCP initialize + tools/list: reachable = both answered, free = reachable and no payment wall
body.erc8004: the ERC-8004 agents in /v1/agents/hireable whose endpoint is this remote (match endpoint), else whose host is its host (match host: a lead, not an identity)
